eligibility: Defined by the future approved EXP-103 protocol; pilot and final samples must be disjoint.
sample_size_rationale: Must be replaced by the frozen statistical analysis plan before a main run.
assignment: Blocked: requires approved randomization or deterministic agent assignment.
counterbalancing: Blocked: requires the approved treatment/task ordering plan.
task_order: Use immutable task IDs; final order is not selected in this template.
environment: Pin OS, CPU, memory, Node, package manager, provider/model/prompt and repository commits.
stop_rule: No main run until ethics, data, statistical and Lead gates are approved.
exclusions: Never silently remove failures, deviations, inconclusive runs or stopped runs.
